purpose: Apply the V26 discovery sequence to a causally routed two-engine candidate: freeze an economically interpretable high-breadth candidate, render every pre-2021 signal with six months before and after, inspect every chart, compress repeated structures to at most five causal rules, and only then run a frozen rule replay.

candidate.causal_market_router: Use the already completed same-date cross-sectional market state. BEAR and BULL use different engines; TRANSITION holds cash. No future index or stock return defines state.

bear_engine.economic_sequence: In causal BEAR after a fast stock capitulation, a large high-location demand bar clears recent supply while completed broad-market breadth is improving.
bear_engine.entry_exit: next legal open, +10% target or H20 next legal open, no stop, 40 bp round trip

bull_engine.source_identity: exact ASHARE-BULL-QUIET-PLATFORM-DUAL-DEMAND-V24 candidates with completed T15_H15_NO_STOP outcomes
bull_engine.economic_sequence: In causal BULL, a narrow sixty-session platform and lower recent turnover represent quiet inventory. A tradable 1%-8% upward gap, >=1.5x turnover, high close and platform breakout must be confirmed either by simultaneous positive market-and-industry majority demand or by an idiosyncratic >=2% information jump over the PIT industry.

dual_demand_identity.synchronized: same-day market and PIT-industry median returns are positive and both positive-return shares exceed 50%
dual_demand_identity.idiosyncratic: when synchronized majority demand is absent, upward opening gap is at least 2% and stock session return exceeds PIT-industry median session return by at least 2%

bull_engine.entry_exit: next legal open, +15% target or H15 next legal open, no stop, 40 bp round trip

frozen_candidate_snapshot.disclosure: Both source engines and their development outcomes were already observed. These figures select a chart-study candidate and are not independent confirmation.

chart_questions: Does the signal begin a new price-discovery leg or occur at the end of an exhausted prior move?
Is overhead supply visibly compact and recently tested, or remote and unstable?
Does demand remain accepted after the signal without requiring future information at the revised decision time?
Which causal market direction and participation dynamics distinguish successful BEAR repair from successful BULL continuation?
Are severe losses preceded by a visible, causally measurable contradiction of the engine's economic premise?
